title: Impact of Depression on Thermoregulation
official: Thermoregulatory Responses to Heat Stress in Adults With Major Depressive Disorder With and Without Antidepressant Treatment
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if, compared to non-depressed adults, differences exist in skin blood flow and sweating responses to passive heat stress in adults with clinically diagnosed depression, those with depression who are prescribed and taking SSRIs and those with depression who are prescribed and taking SNRIs.
